title.en: Why Diagonal Movement Is 41% Faster: Vector Basics for Games & Graphics
title.vi: Vì sao đi chéo nhanh hơn 41%? Vector cơ bản cho game & đồ hoạ

summary.en: Why does a game character move about 41% faster diagonally? In five minutes, Inko the octopus builds vectors from the ground up: adding, subtracting, scaling, length and normalizing, and fixes three classic game bugs on the way.
summary.vi: Vì sao nhân vật game đi chéo lại nhanh hơn khoảng 41%? Trong năm phút, bạch tuộc Inko dựng vector từ đầu: cộng, trừ, co giãn, độ dài và normalize, rồi sửa luôn ba lỗi game kinh điển.

en: what a vector is: a displacement, drawn as an arrow or written as numbers
adding tip to tail, and subtracting to aim from one point to another (player − enemy)
scaling to stretch, shrink or flip a vector
length with Pythagoras, and the cheaper squared-length comparison
normalizing to unit length: the diagonal-speed bug and the zero-vector NaN trap
position, direction and velocity, and the game loop position += velocity * dt
vi: vector là gì: một độ dời, vẽ thành mũi tên hoặc viết thành bộ số
cộng nối đuôi nhau, và trừ để nhắm từ điểm này tới điểm kia (player − enemy)
nhân vô hướng để kéo dài, co lại hoặc lật chiều vector
độ dài theo Pythagoras, và mẹo so bình phương độ dài cho rẻ hơn
normalize về độ dài một: lỗi đi chéo nhanh hơn và cái bẫy NaN của vector 0
vị trí, hướng và vận tốc, cùng vòng lặp game position += velocity * dt

quizzes.question: Two arrows with the same length and direction, drawn at different places, are…
quizzes.explanation: A vector is a displacement: only its length and direction count, not where it starts.

quizzes.question: Which vector points from the enemy to the player?
quizzes.explanation: a − b runs from b to a. Swap the order and the enemy runs away instead.

quizzes.question: What does multiplying a vector by −1.5 do?
quizzes.explanation: A negative number flips the arrow 180°, and |−1.5| = 1.5 makes it one and a half times as long.

quizzes.question: To check which of two vectors is longer, the cheapest correct way compares…
quizzes.explanation: x² + y² keeps the same order as the lengths, and skips the square root.

quizzes.question: W gives (0, 1) and D gives (1, 0). Without normalizing, diagonal movement is…
quizzes.explanation: (1, 1) has length √2 ≈ 1.41. Normalize the sum before multiplying by the speed (and skip it when no key is held).

quizzes.question: An enemy stands exactly on the player. Dividing player − enemy by its length gives…
answers: NaN, and the enemy silently vanishes
quizzes.explanation: The length is 0, so it divides 0 by 0: NaN. NaN spreads with no error, so check the length first.

quizzes.question: A box slides from the origin to (10, 0, 0). Its top normal was (0, 1, 0). Now it is…
quizzes.explanation: A direction has no position, so sliding the object does not change it.
